WITH eligible_drivers AS (
    SELECT d.XCL_034
    FROM drivers d
    WHERE d.XCL_041 = 'German'
      AND STRFTIME('%Y', d.XCL_040) BETWEEN '1980' AND '1990'
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM results r
          WHERE r.XCL_075 = d.XCL_034
            AND r.XCL_088 IS NOT NULL
      )
),
fastest_laps AS (
    SELECT 
        lt.XCL_044 AS driver_id,
        lt.XCL_043 AS race_id,
        lt.XCL_048 AS lap_time_ms
    FROM lapTimes lt
    INNER JOIN eligible_drivers ed ON lt.XCL_044 = ed.XCL_034
    WHERE lt.XCL_048 IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT ps.XCL_054
FROM fastest_laps fl
INNER JOIN pitStops ps ON fl.driver_id = ps.XCL_050 AND fl.race_id = ps.XCL_049
ORDER BY fl.lap_time_ms ASC
LIMIT 1
